arrangements.description: Two supplied examples side by side in two columns; each shows the given expression, the arrowed copy, then blue working.

intentionalDepartures: The source prints the arrowed expression and the first blue working line on one row; the preset layout places the arrowed expression above the aligned blue working (house preset arrangement).
The final line of the right-hand example is black in the source and blue in the first example; treated as a source colour inconsistency and shown as blue working in both.

teachingContext.method: Expand binomial products by multiplying each term in the first bracket by each term in the second bracket, then simplify by collecting like terms.
